sources.entry: Capd - Open-source capture and bookmarking app for saving links, text, notes, and images with full-text search. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jamiedavenport/capd) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Capd
summary.one_liner: Capd is a private, native macOS app for saving web pages, selected text, links, notes, and images and finding them again with full-text search.
use_cases: save web pages to read later
collect links and notes on a Mac
search past captured text and images
keep a private local research library
feed captures to AI assistants via MCP
script captures and exports with the CLI
summary.what_it_does: Capd captures links, selected text, clipboard images, dropped files and readable web page content via a global hotkey (Ctrl+Option+C), menu bar or notch drop target, or the macOS share sheet. A compact HUD confirms saves and lets you add a note. It strips common tracking parameters and merges repeat captures into the existing item. Search (Option+Shift+Space) covers titles, sites, notes, selections, page content and OCR text from images, plus on-device auto-tags. With Apple Intelligence, "Ask Cap" answers natural-language questions and cites its source captures. Data is stored in a local SQLite database and assets folder; a bundled CLI supports capture, search and JSON export, and a read-only MCP server is offered for compatible AI assistants.
notable: Fully local storage in SQLite with no account, sync, analytics or telemetry
Bundled CLI with stable JSON output and read-only MCP server
Ask Cap natural-language search with source links (requires Apple Intelligence)
caveats: Requires Apple Intelligence for the Ask Cap feature
macOS only; no other platforms named
Ask Cap is limited to devices where Apple Intelligence is available
